comment:
* A ListView which has an additional overlay layer. {@link BitmapDrawable}
 * can be added to the layer and can be animated.

methods.name: public void addOverlayObject(OverlayObject object)
methods.comment:
* Adds an object to the overlay layer.
     *
     * @param object An object to be added.

methods.name: public void startAnimationAll()
methods.comment: * Starts all animations of objects in the overlay layer.

methods.name: public void stopAnimationAll()
methods.comment: * Stops all animations of objects in the overlay layer.
